channel.title: UNAM Guitar Prep — 3-Week Listening Course
channel.description: Private, curated listening feed for the three-week UNAM classical-guitar preparation program. Playable items combine verified Radio UAA/iVoox and IMER audio with selected Guitarras del Mundo episodes whose publisher enclosures are copied from the show's public RSS feed resolved through Apple's catalog.
channel.itunes:author: UNAM Guitar Prep — private study feed
channel.itunes:summary: Three-week Spanish listening-comprehension sequence for 20th- and 21st-century classical guitar history, repertoire, pedagogy, and performance, including selected Guitarras del Mundo episodes listed on Apple Podcasts.
